context: A police officer discusses a case
purpose: Teach: 断面/壁面/踊ら/西暦/果たさ/救命/抵触/徴兵

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、現場の断面、絶対、分析、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We're pursuing this case seriously. The site analysis is advancing steadily.
lines.style: Measured, official tone. Clear articulation on procedural terms. Steady pace without rushing. Slight formality — the voice of someone accountable for the words they choose.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 容疑者の家、本気で、絶対、壁面に、絶対、痕跡、絶対、警察、絶対、発見されたんですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: So you found trace evidence on the suspect's wall, then?
lines.style: Thoughtful, searching for confirmation. Slight upward lilt at the end — genuinely curious, not challenging. Careful not to assume. Pauses fractionally before 'wall' as if double-checking the detail.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。容疑者、本気で、絶対、世論に、絶対、踊らされた、絶対、可能性、捜査、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're investigating the possibility that the suspect was swayed by public pressure.
lines.style: Even, measured delivery. Weight settling on 'swayed' — acknowledging the complexity of motive. Professional distance but not cold. The voice of someone explaining an investigation, not defending one.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 西暦、本気で、絶対、事件の発生、絶対、警察、絶対、明らかに、絶対、しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: And the timeline — when the incident occurred — the police have made that clear?
lines.style: Gentle questioning, not pushing. A slight hesitation before 'timeline' suggests he's being careful with terminology. Respectful but engaged. Listening more than performing.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。任務を、本気で、絶対、果たさずに、絶対、警察、絶対、責任、絶対、感じております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Without fulfilling that duty, the police would feel the weight of that responsibility.
lines.style: Quiet gravity. Opening soft but the words themselves are firm. No rush to finish — each phrase lands. The voice of someone who takes the consequence of procedure seriously.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、救命活動、絶対、本当に、立派ですね、絶対、感謝、しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The rescue efforts the police coordinated — that was genuinely impressive work.
lines.style: Sincere, steady admiration without flattery. Voice opens warmly on 'rescue' — he means this. Not performative. The cadence of someone who witnessed competence and is naming it.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。容疑者、本気で、絶対、複数の法に、絶対、抵触、絶対、しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. The suspect is in violation of multiple laws.
lines.style: Clear, factual. No embellishment. The tone of someone stating what is — not arguing it. Brief, official, but not unkind. Matter-of-fact delivery on 'multiple laws'.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 戦時の徴兵、本気で、絶対、警察、絶対、過去の事件、絶対、参考、絶対、にしていますか?本気で、感謝
lines.en: Does the police reference past wartime conscription cases when considering precedent?
lines.style: Thoughtful and deliberate. A pause before 'wartime' — weighing the weight of asking. Respectful of the historical weight. Curious but not clinical. Ends with subtle upward tilt — genuine question seeking real answer.
